name: varg-character-cringe
description: Makes cringe, deadpan, odd-looking AI characters people argue about, on varg: a photoreal, bizarre-but-believable person (strange haircut, wrong suit, absurd shoes) who takes himself completely seriously and repeats one action in a new place every post: the "Jean Phil" format of late 2026. Builds the character sheet and the posting format. Use when someone asks for a weird, cringe, odd, awkward or deadpan character, a strange AI influencer, a "is he real?" persona, or a character like Jean Phil. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).
